ota.summary: Innovo RedBox Fury 2026.09.21.50 - relay outputs reworked into two orthogonal settings. 'Door XX Output Mode' (Momentary/Latching) decides whether a trigger returns to rest; 'Door XX Idle State' (Normally Open/Normally Closed) decides where rest is, and is now reapplied at boot instead of every relay being forced off. Defaults are unchanged for garage use: Normally Open + Momentary + 3s.
